united-states-representative-1st-congres.note: From the Clerk of the House's statistics (compiled from official sources): the district's figures only, no county or precinct figures, until the Secretary of State's 2022 files are saved. Its totals are the same lines, stored once they equal the Clerk's own recapitulation table, so they are not a second control. Declared write-in votes are canvassed apart and are not in these figures.
